subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Diagram in PCC-23, paired with v1-p339-1. (C)MT-INFO (music information) is crossed with CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism): the question is what music information becomes when its progression is *cross-transfer* rather than source-initiation. MT-INFO → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → CRTF-PROG (the crossing). COS-P (cosmic particulars) → MT-INFO; VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) → MT-INFO; RE-ST (restructuralism) → MT-INFO. MT-INFO → LK-IMP (linkage implications). VT-DY also → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) in a parallel sub-chain. AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) → TR-INFO (trans-information) and AFL-DY → INFO-DS (information dissemination) — a third sibling sub-chain. Structural argument: music information is over-determined upstream — fed by cosmic particulars, vibrational dynamics, and restructuralism (three independent feeds). It produces both linkage implications and (via time-continuum implications) cross-transfer progressionalism. The vibrational-dynamics → social-reality-dynamics sub-chain runs in parallel, and the affinity-dynamics → trans-information/information-dissemination sub-chain runs separately — meaning the diagram shows *three structurally parallel paths* through which music's vibrational and affinity reality propagates into culture. Cross-transfer progressionalism is reachable only via the time-continuum implications route, not directly from any of the three constituting feeds. Read against the section: this is Braxton's structural specification of why Young/Riley/Reich/Glass's eastern source-transfer is consequential — it operates at the cross-transfer-progressionalism node downstream of music-information's full constitution.
